svg.aria-label: How I see it: the whole system laid out like a map; find where it breaks; the pattern clicks. Four rules.
svg.text: When I look at a problem, I see the whole
system laid out in front of me, lit up
like a map: every connection, every place
it could break. It feels like magic.
Then I sit with the hunch until the pattern
clicks, and attack my own ideas harder than
